_readme: One entry per file you drop into this folder. The key is the filename.
The build refuses any asset whose licence does not permit commercial use,
and holds back any asset with no entry here until you add one.
author   who made it (required for CC-BY attribution)
source   where you downloaded it from
license  SPDX id where possible: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, MIT, ...
Accepted: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause,

car-sedan.glb.title: Car Concept
car-sedan.glb.author: Eric Chadwick (Khronos Group), from a public-domain model by Unity Fan
car-sedan.glb.notes: Complete exterior with shutlines, wheels, tyres, glass, headlights, mirrors, full interior with dashboard and seats. Khronos logos removed from the shipped build is not required — they are non-copyrightable marks under the model's own licence file.

truck-delivery.glb.title: Cesium Milk Truck
truck-delivery.glb.author: Cesium
truck-delivery.glb.notes: Light delivery truck. Low triangle count, single texture atlas — cheap enough to instance along the corridor.

street-lamp-old.glb.title: Lantern
street-lamp-old.glb.author: sbtron (Microsoft), Draco compression by Frank Galligan
street-lamp-old.glb.notes: Weathered wooden lamp post with full PBR set (base colour, normal, metallic-roughness, emissive).

barrier-cone.glb.title: Traffic Cone
barrier-cone.glb.author: hinndia
barrier-cone.glb.notes: Photoscanned-quality traffic cone with reflective banding. Originally published on Sketchfab under CC BY 4.0.
